description: P0.3: Gen3 forces the merged ability+traits battleConfig (buildGen3AbilityConfig always built, buildTraitsConfig non-null because passives is non-empty). dragon_first_double's extra attack DOES re-invoke the threaded attackerDamageMod hook (unlike half_twice, which skips it entirely) -- power_bracer's flat 1.2x must land on the extra hit's damage too, in the same ability-then-traits order the main hit's own threaded call uses (attackerDamageMod is one of mergeBattleConfigs' four threaded hooks, so it behaves the same whether or not a traits config exists). Also proves whenAttacked/afterAttack(is_extra_attack=True) re-entry through a live merged config rather than null ability_config/traits_config.
